name: like-api
description: Cloudflare Worker API for likes/views using Cloudflare D1 with migrations.

scripts.db:migrate:local: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply likes_db --local
scripts.db:migrate:remote: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply likes_db --remote
scripts.db:migrations:list: npx wrangler d1 migrations list likes_db
scripts.cf:migrate: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply likes_db --remote
scripts.cf:build: npm run cf:migrate && npm run cf:deploy
